provisionNotices.repeats_other_provision: Di Act wey dem publish put di same words for here as section {{repeated}}, under di heading “{{heading}}”. Nobody sabi di correct words for section {{section}} from any copy wey dey available.
provisionNotices.missing_page_secondary_source: Part of dis form no dey di official scan wey we use for here. Di words wey miss come from two different typed copies of di Act wey agree with each other and with di part of di scan wey remain.
provisionNotices.minimum_wage_amended_2024: Di National Minimum Wage (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Di minimum wage for subsection (1) na ₦70,000 now, no be ₦30,000, and di review period for subsection (4) na three years now, no be five. Di words wey you dey see here na di 2019 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s17_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Subsection (2) now dey read "genuineness". For subsection (4), di exclusion now apply "except where they are legally verified in Certified True Copies". Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s21_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Dem must report incident within 72 hours after dem detect am, no be 7 days after e happen, and di report go pass through sectoral CERTs or sectoral Security Operations Centres. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s22_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Subsection (1) now cover people wey public or private organisation engage too, no be only Financial Institution. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s24_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Subsection (1) now cover message wey be pornographic, or wey di person wey send am know say e be lie, to cause breakdown of law and order or pose threat to life. Di former reasons like annoyance and insult don go. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s27_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Subsection (2) now apply to employee of any public or private organisation, no be only financial institution. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s30_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. E now cover any other payment technology means, no be only ATM and Point of Sales terminals. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s37_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Under subsection (1)(a), customers must now still present National Identification Number wey National Identity Management Commission issue. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s38_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Dem don replace subsection (1). Service providers must keep and protect specific traffic data and subscriber information according to di Nigeria Data Protection Act, for two years. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s41_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. Dem don replace paragraphs (d) to (h) of subsection (1) with new paragraphs (d) to (j), wey add sectoral CERTs and Security Operation Centres. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s44_amended: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. E restate di levy, replace subsection (6) with new subsections (6) to (8), and add fine for people wey no remit. From 1 January 2026, section 196(14) of di Nigeria Tax Act 2025 delete subsections (2)(a) and (4) and di Second Schedule, wey be di levy provisions. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s48_amended_2024: Di Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 don change dis section. E delete subsection (4), so di rule wey talk say make dem cancel or hold passport of person wey dem convict no dey apply again. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_second_schedule_deleted: Section 196(14) of di Nigeria Tax Act 2025 delete dis Schedule from 1 January 2026. Di words wey you dey see for here na di 2015 text.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_197_212: Sections 197 to 212 no dey di only copy of dis Act wey we get, so dem no show for here. Dem cover di rest of Public Nuisance, Lotteries and Gaming Houses, Cruelty to Animals and most of Offences relating to Religion.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_364_365: Sections 364 and 365 no dey di only copy of dis Act wey we get, so dem no show for here. Dem cover di punishment for forgery and forgery of public seals.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_410_477: Sections 410 to 477 no dey dis text. E talk say dem dey published for di Penal Code (Northern States) Federal Provisions Act, wey we no get.
provisionNotices.penal_code_s384_penalty_lost: Di only copy of dis Act wey we get lose di end of subsection (1), so di penalty for dis offence no show for here.
